name: Swedish polska (traditional fiddle-dance)
lineage: Swedish polska traditional fiddle-dance tradition of Sweden, comprising several regional sub-types: åttondelspolska (eighth-note-pulse polska), sextondelspolska (sixteenth-note-pulse polska), Slängpolska (swing-polska), and several regional named variants. Performance configuration: solo fiddle, twin-fiddles (svenska låtspel), nyckelharpa (keyed fiddle), or small ensembles of these instruments. Distinguished by the canonical Swedish-fiddle ornamental conventions and the asymmetrical-triple-meter dance-pulse where the second beat is shortened. The post-1970s Swedish folk-music revival under the spelmanslag fiddler-group network consolidated institutional preservation; the annual Riksspelmansträff and Bingsjöstämman fiddle-festivals anchor performance circuit.
